title: Canonical affine coefficient counit coordinate maps
statement: Fix the positive-level finite coefficient conventions [def-pur-conventions], a separated finite-type scheme $Y$ over the fixed field, and the ordered affine tower $X_d,p_d$ with $X_0=Y$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. Use the recorded pullback and derived tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], Tate lines [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], compact supports [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] and ordinary/pro-etale comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. For $r\ge1$ with $\ell^r A=0$, put $N=\ell^r$. Invertibility of $\ell$ implies invertibility of $N$. Let $G_d$ be the actual right adjoint in the ordered affine-line adjunction tower of [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace]. Define $L_d=G_d A_Y$, canonically $A_{X_d}(d)[2d]$, and define $t_d$ by the actual tower counit transported along its specified compact-support comparison; these are the standard-frame vector integration coordinates of [def-amb-vector-integration], with site comparison [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]. For $j:\mathbf A^1_Y\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^1_Y$ and $q:\mathbf P^1_Y\to Y$, put $B=A^e_{\mathbf P^1}(1)[2]$ and $W=j^*B$. The canonical tensor-pullback and pullback-compositor isomorphisms identify $G_1 H$ with $f^*H\otimes W$. Define the line counit in these coordinates by the actual composite open/projective adjunction counit, and define $I_Y=t_q\circ Rq_*(\epsilon_j(B))$, with the specified normalized trace [def-amb-p1-trace]. Define the coefficient-first projection arrow by the canonical compact-support projection [def-exchange-projection] conjugated by the canonical signed derived tensor symmetries [def-kun-derived-tensor], transported to the fixed affine-chart compactification. In the recorded finite-line coordinates [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison], transport these same counit and trace maps along the specified coefficient/source equalities. Realize an ordinary counit on the pro-etale site by the specified compact-support and tensor-source comparison isomorphisms and the retained coefficient representative isomorphism. For two annihilating exponents, define the source transition by tensoring $f^*K$ with the two specified coefficient comparisons through the same fixed pro-etale Tate line. No orientation, adjunction, projection inverse or representative map is chosen arbitrarily.
